outcome: practice_data_counts sixth MCP tool added with tests, listings and README; branch cloud/c1471-mcp-practice-data-counts-b
summary: Added practice_data_counts (functions/_shared/practice-data-counts.js), wired into TOOLS, validateArgs and callTool in mcp.js. GET to the counts endpoint with optional state and segment, redirect manual, 10s timeout, non-200 and failures map to tool errors. New tests/practice-data-counts.test.mjs (7 tests, fetch stubbed). Byte-lock test and serving-m1 tool count (5 to 6) updated. Full suite node --test tests/*.test.mjs: 154 tests, 154 pass, 0 fail. Mutants: dropping the state pattern fails 1 test; filling a suppressed cell with 0 fails 2 tests; both reverted. glama-release/tools.json, mcp.json and README updated; server.json lists no tools so unchanged. No live network used.
boundary: Only the files named in the brief changed; no main push, deploy, PR, secret or production write. The other five tools are unchanged.
findings: The segment enum could not be filled: no network access beyond git and the repo contains only one segment slug (primary-care). The brief forbids inventing slugs, so segment is constrained by pattern ^[a-z0-9-]+$ instead of an enum of 6. Verifier or controller should replace it with the 6 served slugs from the live response or Worker source.
Live endpoint parity not checked from this session; verify against the deployed endpoint.
